messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated for service 'router' -> prod using chart router-chart@3.1.0
deploy-bot: Changeset: bump image to gcr.io/redwood/router:2026-03-20
anya: Noted. Rolling canary 10% in eu-west1
luke: @anya quick heads up — values override includes `sessionAffinity: ClientIP` which isn't in chart schema for 3.1.0
anya: hmm, where did that come from? CI didn't flag it
miguel: I pushed a values patch yesterday to add sticky sessions for legacy clients
eva: Can we abort the canary? I see 502s from upstream in the canary pods
sre-oncall: @anya abort canary. pod logs show helm preflight rejecting unknown field
sre-oncall: log snippet: "Error: failed preflight: values.yaml: line 12: field 'sessionAffinity' not found in schema"
anya: aborting now
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by @anya — reason: post-deploy validation failed
luke: options: 1) pin chart back to router-chart@3.0.4 and re-run 2) remove override from values and re-deploy 3) patch chart schema (fast but risky)
miguel: I'd prefer pinning to 3.0.4 and then open a follow-up to update chart schema+tests
eva: Agreed. We should also record this in release notes: "temporary pin due to values schema mismatch"
anya: +1. @sre-oncall can you perform the rollback/pin? I'll update the release notes and notify docs
sre-oncall: Will do. Running:
```
helm repo update
helm upgrade router stable/router-chart --version 3.0.4 -f values-prod.yaml --namespace prod
```
sre-oncall: Rollback initiated, monitoring events
deploy-bot: Rollback succeeded. router pods now at image gcr.io/redwood/router:2026-03-18
miguel: I'll open an RFC to add `sessionAffinity` to the chart schema and add a validation test in CI
anya: Leave this in the postmortem queue. Also ensure change window note for tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC for the schema bump
eva: I'll add to release notes and ping support to watch for regressions
anya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Thread closed since rollback completed
